summary: Resolved D04-R005-001 by freezing exact terminal Git tree equality: acceptedMainCommit is independently resolved from targetMainRef, finalCommit must be its ancestor, and tree(acceptedMainCommit) must equal tree(finalCommit). Because finalCommit is already proven candidate-equivalent to finalizedCandidateRef, accepted main cannot silently contain additional or different product/canonical bytes. All prior Change 5 boundaries remain unchanged and no new candidate/provider/promotion subsystem is introduced.
